\u27e6CODE5\u27e7: ["```python title=\"joke_app.py\"", "from dataclasses import dataclass", "", "import httpx", "", "from pydantic_ai import Agent, RunContext", "", "", "@dataclass", "class MyDeps:", "    api_key: str", "    http_client: httpx.AsyncClient", "", "    async def instructions_factory(self) -> str:  # (1)!", "        response = await self.http_client.get('https://example.com')", "        response.raise_for_status()", "        return f'Prompt: {response.text}'", "", "", "joke_agent = Agent('openai:gpt-6.1-sol', deps_type=MyDeps)", "", "", "@joke_agent.instructions", "async def get_instructions(ctx: RunContext[MyDeps]) -> str:", "    return await ctx.deps.instructions_factory()  # (2)!", "", "", "async def application_code(prompt: str) -> str:  # (3)!", "    ...", "    ...", "    # now deep within application code we call our agent", "    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:", "        app_deps = MyDeps('foobar', client)", "        result = await joke_agent.run(prompt, deps=app_deps)  # (4)!", "    return result.output", "```"]
